title: Majnin Slovakia
description: Just a normal Minecraft Survival server with a few Plugins and Datapacks
body: Just a simple Minecraft Survival Server with a few plugins and datapacks, that make the gameplay better. Main language is Slovak but we also speak English easily. The server has Voice Chat but you don't have to use it, if you don't want to. GriefPrevention is installed, so is CoreProtect and EssentialsX
